name: product_ux_review_deep_v1
description: Deep product UX review for PMs, founders, and design leads working on conversion-critical flows. Use this for onboarding, checkout, approval, dashboard, or landing-page audits when you need a PM-ready brief, not aesthetic commentary. Returns structured JSON with flow map, priority issues, IA recommendation, state-policy guidance, and experiment plan.

url.description: URL of the product to review. Can be used as a shorthand — surfaceType, artifactLinks, and other fields will be inferred.

focus.description: What to focus the review on, for example onboarding flow or checkout experience.

surfaceType.description: Surface under review, for example web app, dashboard, mobile app, or landing page. Defaults to 'web app' when url is provided.

productSummary.description: Short summary of the product and the business context.

targetUser.description: Primary user or decision-maker for this UX surface.

primaryGoal.description: Main user outcome this review should optimize.

primaryFlow.description: Critical happy path written as a short sequence.

artifactLinks.description: Links to screenshots, staging pages, Figma frames, or product docs.

currentIA.description: Current information architecture, nav model, or content grouping. Defaults to 'not provided'.

coreScreensOrStates.description: Key screens or states that must be included in the review. Defaults to ['main screen'].

changeBudget.description: Expected implementation budget such as low, medium, or high. Defaults to 'medium'.

successMetrics.description: Metrics that define success for this redesign or audit. Defaults to ['task completion rate'].
